name: SushiArt (Dubai Mall, DIFC Marble Walk and other branches)
questions: Is GF soy sauce available at every branch and in delivery orders?
Is the truffle topping or sauce on the tuna GF?
Which rolls have tempura flakes or crab sticks?
quinoa_oat_flags: Unknown. Some sushi chains offer quinoa rolls or bowls, so check.

safe_dishes.note: Named by a GF reviewer as a good GF choice

summary: Celiac diners report GF soy sauce at the Dubai Mall branch and good GF sushi choices. It's a convenient chain option to confirm per branch.
tamari_source: A FindMeGlutenFree reviewer at the Dubai Mall branch said it's a chain and they offer GF soy sauce. Another praised 'excellent choices for GF sushi such as tuna with white truffle'. On Atly (DIFC), a reviewer said staff helped with their gluten allergy.
